text: I went for a pregnancy check-up because I'm receiving prenatal care in another province, but I have to travel to Chiang Mai for work. I told the doctor I wanted to check on my baby's development, but when she found out I wouldn't be receiving prenatal care at her clinic, she just walked out of the room. She only checked the heartbeat; she didn't measure the baby's size at all. It wasn't okay at all.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเจริญพันธ์
text: Dr. Thong is very skilled at treating patients and the treatment fee is not as expensive as I thought. Since I received treatment at the Fertility Clinic, whenever I had a problem, Dr. Thong was also able to provide advice. He was very willing to give advice over the phone. I highly recommend him. He is also very kind. ❤️
